correctness.rationale: Reconstructed exact factor equality at each length by extending the previous length's equivalence class by one bit, grouped all cyclic starts, and expanded occurrence masks with rotations. Independently reproduced both ten-entry profiles and all ten factor counts and checked the displayed witnesses and every position's dual load from the raw JSON (python3 /workspace/reproduce_reviews.py 4). Each dual mass is strictly above gamma-1 and each position has load at most 1; summing over an attractor therefore supplies the integer lower bound. At 1024 the independent result is 868847 factors, 55 minimal coverages and minimum 7, with 21 distinct weighted factors of total 51/8 and maximum positional load 1. For any minimal coverage M, its complement hits every other distinct coverage (none is contained in M), so every equivalent subfamily must retain M. All nonminimal coverages follow from a minimal one. This verifies uniqueness for subfamilies of distinct coverages, not uniqueness of optimum position sets. The result stops at 1024.

value.rationale: This is a contiguous census of natural dyadic stages of a canonical automatic word. It records the exact optimization invariant and the size of the equivalent canonical constraint system, with portable upper witnesses and very small, integral-dual lower certificates. The circular and ordinary minima already differ at n=8, and at n=1024 reducing 868847 factors to 55 constraints gives substantive exact benchmark data for circular-attractor algorithms without extrapolating.
